Container.Name: PowerShellDocker
Container.Overview:
A Docker container that runs PowerShell (pwsh) with the PSWSMan/WSMan modules pre-installed, based on mcr.microsoft.com/powershell.
Mount your scripts into the Scripts Path below. By default the container runs a bundled keep-alive script; set Script File to the name of a script already in your Scripts Path to run that instead. Use Extra Software to install additional apt packages when the container starts, and Fallback DNS to control the DNS server used if the container's automatic DNS resolution fails.
Source, Dockerfile and entrypoint script: https://github.com/KrX3D/PowershellDocker
Container.Requires: This container has no web UI -- it is driven entirely by environment variables and a mounted scripts folder. Place your .ps1 scripts in the Scripts Path below.

Config.Name: Scripts Path
Config.Description: Path to your PowerShell scripts directory, mounted into the container at /scripts.

Config.Name: Script File
Config.Description: Name of a .ps1 file already inside the Scripts Path to run instead of the bundled default keep-alive script (DockerDefault.ps1). Leave empty to run the default script.

Config.Name: Extra Software
Config.Description: Space-separated list of additional apt packages to install when the container starts, e.g. 'git curl'.

Config.Name: Fallback DNS
Config.Description: DNS server written to /etc/resolv.conf if the container's automatic DNS resolution fails at startup.

Config.Name: PowerShell Telemetry Opt-Out
Config.Description: Set to 1 (default) to disable PowerShell telemetry, or 0 to allow it.
